aiMemory.openDescription: Turn your expertise into richer, more accurate content that truly reflects your business.
aiMemory.webLengthHint: Controls iNrCy Site, external website and iNr’Search.
aiMemory.socialLengthHint: Controls Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and Google Business.
aiMemory.lengthAdapted: Adaptive — AI chooses for each channel
aiMemory.title: Business DNA
aiMemory.description: One shared knowledge base for all your content: the more precise it is, the more the AI writes like a true partner for your business.
aiMemory.scoreHelp: It shows how much useful information has already been added to your business DNA. The higher it is, the more precisely iNrCy can personalise your content.
aiMemory.completionHint: This score is only a guide: no field is required and it never blocks the application.
aiMemory.analysisDescription: iNrCy analyses your website, Google Business Profile and connected channels to enrich your Business DNA automatically.
aiMemory.analysisChannelIncluded: Included in the Business DNA analysis
aiMemory.analysisChannelNotIncluded: Status shown, not included in the Business DNA analysis
aiMemory.analysisLaunchHint: Launch the analysis once your channels are connected!
aiMemory.analysisPrivacy: Only authorised business content is used. Login data and private messages are never analysed.
aiMemory.analysisError: Channel analysis could not be completed. Please try again shortly.
aiMemory.analysisApplied: Suggestions added to the draft: {fields} sections enriched and {items} new items. Review and save them.
aiMemory.analysisNoChange: The analysis found no sufficiently reliable new information to add.
aiMemory.profileLinkHint: Identity, contact details, sector and profession.
aiMemory.loadError: Unable to load your Business DNA. Please try again.
aiMemory.saveError: Unable to save your Business DNA. Please try again.
aiMemory.foundationDescription: Sector and profession remain in My profile. Each new profession automatically prepares its suggested services here.
aiMemory.baseServicesEmpty: First choose your sector and profession in My profile to receive automatic suggestions.
aiMemory.identityDescription: Explain what you do and adapt the automatically suggested services to your real business.
aiMemory.detailedDescriptionPlaceholder: Your story, how you work, what drives you, your experience, your area and useful business specifics…
aiMemory.expertiseDescription: Define what drives your business and the signals that make it recognisable.
aiMemory.missionPlaceholder: e.g. make digital communication simple and accessible to professionals…
aiMemory.audienceDescription: Help the AI speak to the right people with the right arguments.
aiMemory.localPresenceDescription: Define where you work and when customers can contact you.
aiMemory.openingScheduleHint: Set each day like a calendar. These hours automatically feed your content and local tools.
aiMemory.languageDescription: Specify the words that sound like you and those the AI must never use.
aiMemory.forbiddenVocabularyPlaceholder: e.g. the best in the region
aiMemory.premiumDescription: Three levers for more commercial, reasoned and planned content.
aiMemory.premiumLocked: These three blocks are visible but reserved for Premium accounts.
aiMemory.offersLabel: Offers, ranges, indicative prices and arguments
aiMemory.offersPlaceholder: Describe your main offers, what they include, who they are for, their benefits and any conditions. Include only true information.
aiMemory.proofsPlaceholder: Certifications, years of experience, methods, real guarantees, frequent objections and your answers…
aiMemory.editorialLabel: Editorial strategy, seasonality and recurring themes
aiMemory.editorialPlaceholder: Priority topics, strong seasons, events, cadence, recurring angles and topics to avoid…
aiMemory.saved: Your Business DNA is saved and will be used from the next generation.
aiMemory.cancelMessage: All unsaved Business DNA changes will be lost.
aiMemory.resetMessage: All visible sections will be cleared. You will then need to save to confirm the reset.

aiConfiguration.pageDescription: Set how AI writes and adapts every piece of content to your goals.
aiConfiguration.voiceCardDescription: Choose how your business addresses its audience.

aiConfiguration.instructionsDescription: Show what you like and define the rules the AI must always follow.
aiConfiguration.emojiHint: Choose the emoji level; the AI then adapts it to each channel.
aiConfiguration.likedContentPlaceholder: Paste a post or text whose tone and structure you like…
aiConfiguration.likedContentHint: The AI identifies the tone, rhythm and structure to follow without copying the text.
aiConfiguration.customInstructionsPlaceholder: E.g. Always explain the concrete benefit, never invent a price or deadline, avoid excessive claims and end posts with a question…
aiConfiguration.customInstructionsHint: Add mandatory rules, restrictions, words to avoid and formulations you never want to use.
